description: Itemizes the out-the-door price of a car from its selling price: rebates, doc fee, add-ons, sales tax with the state's rules and, given a city or county, its local rate (7,000+ places in 23 states), and title and registration. Optionally adds a trade-in (and the tax it saves where the state credits it), a down payment and a loan payment, and compares the doc fee with the state's cap and the total with a walk line. Use it for the total cost of a price; for a dealer's quote, use check_quote. Returns each line, the total and a planner link.

add_ons.description: Dealer add-ons and their prices (paint protection, VIN etching, a service contract)

name.description: What the dealer calls the add-on

apr.description: Loan APR in percent, for the payment

buyer_in_chicago.description: Illinois only: the buyer's address is in the City of Chicago (the city and county given are the dealer's)

buyer_in_cook_county.description: Illinois only: the buyer's address is in Cook County

city.description: City or county in the state's rate table (23 states; state_rules says which), like Pittsburgh or Allegheny County: sets the combined rate from the state's own rate file. Where a city is in several counties (Chicago, Milwaukee), give county too. A place name only, never an address or ZIP

city_mpg.description: Washington DC only: the vehicle's EPA city MPG, with its weight

condition.description: New or used: a state's tax can apply to new cars only (Oregon)

county.description: County from the state's list (Pennsylvania, Nevada, Wisconsin; state_rules lists them), like Allegheny County: sets the combined rate. A county name only, never an address or ZIP

doc_fee.description: Doc fee; leave out to assume the state's cap, or a typical $450 where there is none

electric.description: Washington DC only: a battery-electric vehicle (its own, lower column)

price.description: Vehicle selling price before rebates, fees and tax

rebates.description: Maker rebates taken off at signing

state.description: Two-letter state code (DC included), like PA

tax_rate.description: Combined sales tax rate as a decimal; leave out to use the state's rate

term_months.description: Loan term in months, for the payment

title_reg.description: Title and registration; leave out for a typical $250

trade_payoff.description: What is still owed on the trade-in

vehicle_weight_lbs.description: Washington DC only: the vehicle's unladen weight in pounds (DC's excise rate goes by weight and city MPG)

walk_line.description: The walk line, out the door

name: out_the_door
title: Out-the-door estimate
